items.name: wenlan
items.description: A living wiki your AI writes from your notes, code, AI chats (memories), and docs, checked against sources. It flags what it can’t back up and updates pages when sources change. Supports Claude, Codex, Obsidian...

items.name: hyperbolic-gateway
items.description: Hyperbolic Gateway: a self-hosted web browser for agents and humans - a real Chromium browser your LLM can drive. Local-first, no cloud, no API keys, no telemetry. A DIY alternative to browser-use, Playwright agents and hosted browser clouds.

items.name: vsc-vscodecontroller
items.description: Script VS Code and GitHub Copilot Chat like an API. Pick the model, send prompts, wait for results and keep edits over a local JSON-RPC socket. Built for agent evals, CI and automation.

items.name: dagu
items.description: Self-hostable workflow orchestrator for teams whose main work isn't orchestration. Declarative YAML over your scripts, SSH commands, containers, etc; keep workflows separate from business logic. One binary, no database, runs on limited H/W resources. Alternative to Airflow / Cron / Job Scheduler.

items.name: Claude-Guardian
items.description: Claude Guardian is an all-in-one Claude account safety and risk prevention skill.Claude防封实战 It intelligently assesses your device, account history, network environment, and payment options, then provides personalized guidance for local, VPS, or virtual machine setups.

items.name: gopher-mcp
items.description: C++ MCP SDK - build Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients in C++ / CPP. Enterprise-grade security, observability, connectivity. Stdio, HTTP+SSE, Streamable HTTP, WebSocket, TCP transports. Bindings for Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, C#.

items.name: adsap
items.description: Launch and manage Meta and Google Ads from your AI assistant. You approve every change first.

items.name: etsy-v3-api-client
items.description: TypeScript SDK for Etsy Open API v3, featuring OAuth 2.0 PKCE, automatic token refresh, and browser/Node.js support.

items.name: aide
items.description: Spec-driven development for AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Copilot) — specs, skills and a dashboard that runs them.

items.name: xcrew
items.description: Your Xcode crew inside Claude Code: three MCP servers working as one, with live build progress and test reports Claude can act on.
